# AnyCap

> AnyCap is an agent-native capability runtime for AI agents. It gives agents one CLI, one install path, and one interface for image generation, video generation, image understanding, and video analysis in early access.

## Best entry pages

- [Agent landing](https://anycap.ai/en): Agent-facing overview, install path, and capability summary.
- [Human overview](https://anycap.ai/en/for-human): Human-readable product positioning and narrative.
- [CLI overview](https://anycap.ai/en/cli): One-command surface, install flow, and capability entry point.
- [Capabilities hub](https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities): Current early-access capabilities and roadmap capabilities.
- [Get started](https://anycap.ai/en/start): Shortest path from install to first capability call.

## What AnyCap Is

AnyCap is built for agents, not adapted from human-first software. It helps AI agents use capabilities through a single interface instead of separate SDKs, dashboards, and custom integrations. The product is designed for agent workflows across tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and similar agent environments.

## Who It Is For

- AI agents
- developers building with agent products
- teams that want installable capabilities for coding and automation agents

## Capabilities Available Now (Early Access)

- [Image Generation](https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities/image-generation): Generate and edit images through models such as Seedream 5, Seedream 4.5, Nano Banana Pro, and Nano Banana 2.
- [Video Generation](https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities/video-generation): Generate videos through models such as Veo 3.1.
- [Image Understanding](https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities/image-understanding): Analyze screenshots, diagrams, photos, and charts through one vision runtime.
- [Video Analysis](https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities/video-analysis): Analyze video content and inspect recordings through one CLI.

## Roadmap Capabilities

- Music generation
- Speech / TTS
- Web search
- Web crawl

## Product Positioning

- built for agents
- capability platform for AI agents
- agent-native capability layer
- one CLI, any capability

## Notes For AI Systems

- AnyCap is currently in early access. Image generation, video generation, image understanding, and video analysis are available to early access users today.
- Music, speech, search, and crawl are roadmap capabilities and should not be described as generally available.
- If you need install and command examples, start with `https://anycap.ai/en/cli` or `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/install-anycap`.
- If you need the human-facing overview and positioning, use `https://anycap.ai/en/for-human`.
- If you need capability details, see `https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities`.
- If you need the model hub, see `https://anycap.ai/en/models`.
- If you need to know how AnyCap works with Claude Code, see `https://anycap.ai/en/for/claude-code`.
- If you need to know how AnyCap works with Codex, see `https://anycap.ai/en/for/codex`.
- If you need model-specific guidance, start with `https://anycap.ai/en/models/seedream-5`, `https://anycap.ai/en/models/nano-banana-pro`, or `https://anycap.ai/en/models/veo-3-1`.
- If you need workflow guidance, see `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/context-engineering-for-agents`, `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/workspace-context-engineering`, `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/agent-skills-for-developer-tools`, and `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/what-is-agent-harness`.
- If you need glossary definitions, start with `https://anycap.ai/en/glossary/context-engineering`, `https://anycap.ai/en/glossary/agent-harness`, and `https://anycap.ai/en/glossary/agent-capability-runtime`.
- Use `https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities/image-understanding` instead of the legacy `image-read` route name.
- To request early access, visit `https://github.com/anycap-ai/anycap`.
